item.title: Ukraine mourns 'collector of souls' Oleksiy Yukov, killed recovering war dead
item.description: Oleksiy Yukov spent two decades recovering the bodies of soldiers — including many Russians. He was killed during a recovery mission after stepping on a landmine.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Switzerland is a neutral nation but has more nuclear bunkers than any country in the world
item.description: Instead of scrapping its network of bomb shelters after the Cold War, Switzerland kept building them. The country has more than 370,000 nuclear bomb shelters. Some are now used to house migrants.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: A tale of two very different horny movies
item.description: One Night Only manages to fail as a dystopia and as a rom-com. Meanwhile, Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma is a perfect tale for this moment — if you don't mind your eroticism with a side of gore.

item.title: Federal funds can't be used to give test strips to drug users, raising overdose fears
item.description: Drug addiction groups are reeling after Trump officials said federal grants cannot be used to hand out test strips to drug users. The strips help users check street drugs for dangerous adulterants.

item.title: How Jim James and Jeff Tweedy learned to love the Grateful Dead
item.description: Jim James of My Morning Jacket and Jeff Tweedy of Wilco are two artists who've dipped their toes into the Grateful Dead extended universe through a singular experience: by sharing the stage with Bob Weir.

item.title: Senate votes to confirm Todd Blanche as attorney general
item.description: The Senate confirmed Blanche by a 50-49 vote early Saturday morning, elevating President Trump's former personal lawyer to head the Justice Department.
